description:
The Property to be soLd is located in the Township of East Brunswick
County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey
Commonly known as 20 Ayers Court, East Brunswick, New Jersey 08816
TAX LOT 2-C0020 BLock NO 2.03
Dimension of Lot approximately
Nearest Cross Street
ALL that certain lot, parcel or tract of land, situate and lying in the Township of East Brunswick, County of Middlesex, State of New Jersey, and being more particularly described as follows: BEING KNOWN AND DESIGNATED As Unit 20 in building No. 22, in “Crosspointe Condominium”, together with an undivided .21141 percentage interest in and to the common elements appurtenant thereto, in accordance with, and subject to the terms, conditions, provisions, covenants, restrictions, easements, and other matters contained in the Master Deed for said Crosspointe Condominium, which Master Deed was dated 9/30/1986, and recorded on 9/30/1986 in the Clerk’s Office of the County of Middlesex, in Deed Book 3557, Page 518; First Amendment recorded 10/13/1987 in Deed Book 3652, Page 494 as the same may hereafter be lawfully amended.
FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY: Also known as Lot 2 C0020 in Block 2.03 on the Township of East Brunswick Tax Map. -
THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION
PRIOR LIENS/ENCUPIBRANCES: NONE
UPSET AMOUNT: $68,290.00
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale and satisfaction of the lien debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to the Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person’s cLaim and askingfor an order directing payment of the surplus money, The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
